Calculation.Text: /* fmJAML_LogoFun_Encrypt ( pText ; pEncryptionKey ; pEncrypt1Decrypt0 ) +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | Important Note: this function has nothing to do with fmJAML itself! | +-------------------------------------------------------------------------+ Encrypts or decrypts the fmJAML-Logo using the pEncryptionKey. This just-for-fun function uses a crazy compression technique which is only suitable for texts with a very low number of unique characters and high repetition: Using each character of the encryption key characters are replaced in pText… - when decrypting / expanding the character is replaced with the character's tokens, and - when encrypting / compressing the character's tokens are replaced with the character A character's tokens are constructed from the non-zero digits of a character's unicode code point. The encryption key has been carefully constructed, together with the mapping of the digits, defined in the subfunction, to prove that fmJAML is the answer to your FileMaker JSON problems. This table shows how the phrase characters are mapped to tokens, and what compression occurs.
